Bill.BriefDescription: Developing plans to address the housing needs of homeless persons.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to developing plans to address the housing needs ofhomeless persons; adding a new section to chapter 36.01 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 35.21 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter35A.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each county shall create a task force to develop a tenyearplan addressing shortterm and longterm housing for homeless persons. Membership on the task force must include representatives of thecounties, cities, towns, housing authorities, civic and faithorganizations, schools, community networks, human services providers,law enforcement personnel, criminal justice personnel, includingprosecutors, probation officers, and jail administrators, substanceabuse treatment providers, mental health care providers, emergencyhealth care providers, businesses, at-large representatives of thecommunity, and a homeless or formerly homeless individual. In lieu of creating a new task force, a local government maydesignate an existing body which substantially conforms to this section p. 1 SSB 5767and which includes at least one homeless or formerly homelessindividual to serve as its homeless representative. Those countieswhich participate in the Washington state balance of state continuum ofcare under the McKinney-Vento homelessness assistance act may designatetheir participation efforts to comply with the requirements of thissection. (2) In addition to developing a tenyear plan to end homelessness,each task force shall establish guidelines, as needed, for thefollowing: (a) Emergency shelters; (b) Shortterm housing needs; (c) Temporary encampments; (d) Supportive housing for chronically homeless persons; and (e) Longterm housing. Guidelines must include, when appropriate, standards for health andsafety and notifying the public of proposed facilities to house thehomeless. (3) Each county, including counties exempted from creating a newtask force under subsection (1) of this section, shall report to theappropriate committees of the legislature and to the department ofcommunity, trade, and economic development by January 2006, includinginformation on guidelines developed, potentials for public-privatepartnerships to address homelessness, and requests for furtherinvolvement or support from the legislature. Those counties whichparticipate in the Washington state balance of state continuum of careunder the McKinney-Vento homelessness assistance act may submit asingle report reflecting information on all participating counties.Each county shall continue to develop and coordinate planning efforts,with reports to the legislature of substantive changes and significantadditional information.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each city or town must participate in the task force created undersection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each code city must participate in the task force created undersection 1 of this act.
